entities.summary: Ivan Gonta, also known in contemporary sources as Gontenko ; c. 1705 – 1768) was one of the leaders of the Koliivshchyna, an armed rebellion of peasants and Ukrainian Cossacks against Bar confederation in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
